summary_en: Completion of acquisition of 4,198 Series 2 Class 7 preferred shares at ¥503,427.40 per share (¥2.113 billion total, 88.88% of outstanding preferred) via agreed acquisition announced 23 June 2026. Settlement on 17 August 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding completion of acquisition of treasury shares relating to Series 2 Class 7 preferred stock
translation_en_brief: Chiba Kogyo Bank announced completion of the acquisition of 4,198 Series 2 Class 7 preferred shares on 17 August 2026. The acquisition was conducted via agreed acquisition (有償取得) with all holders of the Series 2 Class 7 preferred stock. Each share was acquired at ¥503,427.40, comprising the ¥500,000 par amount plus ¥3,427.40 in accrued preferred period-end dividend from 1 April 2026 through the acquisition date (based on a ¥9,000 annual rate). Total consideration was ¥2,113,388,093. The 4,198 shares represent 88.88% of the outstanding Series 2 Class 7 preferred shares (excluding treasury holdings). This acquisition was authorized under the company's articles of incorporation and had been announced on 23 June 2026.
